title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: soundboard master cassette-> cassette-> DAT-> CDR-> .WAV-> SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy 1982 show, highlighted by a stellar Lazy Lightning > Supplication and tight Saint jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as frantic, tightly played and full of sweet second‑set jamming, with the Lazy Lightning > Supplication segue singled out as a must‑hear moment. The soundboard source delivers clear, punchy audio (even earning a five‑star rating from one reviewer), though the stream misses the first three songs.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (4–5 stars) and strong praise for both musical performance and sound quality lead to a weighted average around 4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix with very good overall sound; only issue noted is the missing first three songs in the streamed file.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set features sweet, extended jamming and a high‑energy vibe; overall flow is praised as frantic and engaging.

band_member_comments.Drums: Jam after drums highlighted positively, indicating solid drum work.
